answer: SPDZ runs multi-party computation with information-theoretic MACs on every share, and the marble of the protocol is that any tampered share is detected when the MACs are checked. A lagoon of the design is the offline preprocessing phase, which produces authenticated multiplication triples before the real inputs arrive. For identity, a group of validators can jointly check uniqueness without revealing their private lists, and a fable of Sybil accounts cannot pass the check because their shares fail authentication.
